title: PipelineManifest
description: Declarative pipeline definition. Selected by name at enqueue and walked by the deterministic worker orchestrator. The manifest declares POLICY: which stages run, in what order, what each produces, and where review-mode gates. It does NOT declare mechanism: how a stage decides it is 'done' (artifact-presence vs. freshness) lives in the worker step registry, keyed by stage name. Adding a stage here without a matching registry entry is a load-time error.

name.description: Unique manifest name; the file is <name>.yaml and cfg.pipeline references it.

version.description: Manifest version. Bump on any stage-list change; snapshotted into cfg.json (Principle 7) so a re-run uses the pipeline it was built with.

category.description: Coarse family; used by the selection resolver, not by execution.

stability.description: 'test' pipelines are runnable but excluded from bulk production.

default_checkpoint_policy.description: auto = run straight through (today's behavior). guided = honor per-stage human_approval_on_review_mode. Review mode is a POLICY on any pipeline, not a separate pipeline.

bulk_production_accepted.description: Whether this pipeline may be selected for batch enqueue.

mode.description: Lusora orchestrates in code (a deterministic loop), not by an AI agent. AI appears only in bounded stage bodies (script, plan_beats). The enum is intentionally single-valued to keep that decision explicit.

compatible_themes.description: Advisory theme compatibility for the selection UI; not enforced at run time.

stages.description: Ordered list. The orchestrator runs each stage whose produced artifact is absent (resume = skip what exists). Bootstrap (claim + materialize cfg.json) runs BEFORE this list and is not a stage.

name.description: Must match a key in the worker step registry.

requires.description: Artifact names expected present before this stage runs. ADVISORY in v1: the orchestrator runs stages in manifest order and each stage reads what it needs; declared so the loader can validate the DAG and future selection/skip logic has the data.

produces.description: Artifact name(s) this stage writes to the video folder. A stage with no 'produces' (e.g. validate, qa) judges rather than emits and therefore always runs.

checkpoint_required.description: Reserved for guided policy; ignored under auto.

human_approval_on_review_mode.description: Under guided policy, pause for human approval after this stage.

substages.description: Optional finer phases (e.g. the beats process). Faceless v1 declares none - model the flat reality; add when the beats restructure lands.
